product_updates.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
product_updates.content: As part of a planned Texas data center, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could reportedly become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States.

product_updates.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
product_updates.content: NextSlide says its team members are now working on ChatGPT.
